children: Ireland’s seasonally adjusted unemployment rate rose to 5.0% in August 2026, matching the rate in the previous month and slightly exceeding the 4.9% recorded a year earlier.
The total number of unemployed people decreased by 1,200 from the previous month but increased by 1,900 from a year earlier, reaching 147,100.
By gender, the unemployment rate for females edged down to 5.1% from 5.2% in July, with the number of unemployed women falling by 1,300 to 72,500.
For males, the unemployment rate remained unchanged at 4.8%, with the number of unemployed men inching up by 100 to 74,600.
Meanwhile, youth unemployment among those aged 15–24 ticked down to 12.3% in August from 12.4% in July, while the rate for those aged 25–74 also dropped to 3.9% from 4.0%.

title: Ireland Jobless Rate Holds at 5%
